purpose: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-COMP1-FOLD-A-V1: Read against the IN-CHAIN A/A, never against the sealed comparator alone (instrument rules 3 and 4). PRIMARY: intent accuracy (scenario_action exact), paired per row, 10,000 bootstrap draws. GUARD: official pooled SLU-F1 non-inferior at the plan's own null (h_SLU 1.2485). ADMITTED: the intent CI95 lower bound above zero AND the guard holds AND the declared expected_effect_pp was declared before the seal. NEUTRAL: both guards non-inferior at the own null (h_intent 0.9943 / h_SLU 1.2485) without an admitted gain -- read under owner decision 138 as a CONFLICT DIAGNOSIS over the per-class attribution table, never as 'no gain'; no further element is admitted on top of an unresolved conflict. HARMFUL: a measured loss on either guard (decision 25). The citation part (decision 152) is admitted on the composed arm's own no-harm reading and is never reported as a gain. Every verdict carries the per-class attribution table with each row's outcome, the per-stratum tables in both weightings, the frontier row, the delivery check and the token delta.
quality_read_gate: No task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist for BOTH the COMP-1 arm and its in-chain A/A replicate, and before the coordinator's declared expected_effect_pp is on the record. A verdict computed against the sealed comparator alone is refused.
